SELECT DISTINCT t1."XCL_174" FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1."XCL_171" = t2."XCL_177" WHERE t2."XCL_187" = 'Safe'

SELECT CAST(SUM(T1."XCL_126") AS REAL) / COUNT(T1."XCL_121") FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1."XCL_121" = T2."XCL_006" INNER JOIN Country AS T3 ON T2."XCL_007" = T3."XCL_001" WHERE T3."XCL_002" = 'Italy'
SELECT "XCL_123" FROM Player WHERE "XCL_126" > 180 ORDER BY "XCL_123" LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT("XCL_121") FROM Player WHERE "XCL_125" > '1990' AND "XCL_123" LIKE 'Aaron%'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t1."XCL_128" = 6 THEN t1."XCL_153" ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t1."XCL_128" = 23 THEN t1."XCL_153" ELSE 0 END) FROM Player_Attributes AS t1
SELECT "XCL_128" FROM Player_Attributes WHERE "XCL_134" = 'right' ORDER BY "XCL_133" DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(t1."XCL_128") FROM Player_Attributes AS t1 WHERE t1."XCL_134" = 'left' AND t1."XCL_137" = (SELECT MAX("XCL_137") FROM Player_Attributes)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN "XCL_155" > 80 AND "XCL_154" > 80 THEN "XCL_128" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT("XCL_128") FROM Player_Attributes AS t
SELECT "XCL_002" FROM Country WHERE "XCL_001" IN (SELECT "XCL_004" FROM League WHERE "XCL_005" = 'Poland Ekstraklasa')
SELECT t2."XCL_015", t2."XCL_016" FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1."XCL_003" = t2."XCL_008" WHERE t1."XCL_005" = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND t2."XCL_011" LIKE '2008-09-24%'
SELECT "XCL_148", "XCL_149", "XCL_147" FROM Player_Attributes WHERE "XCL_130" IN (SELECT "XCL_122" FROM Player WHERE "XCL_123" = 'Alexis Blin')
SELECT DISTINCT t1."XCL_180" FROM Team_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Team AS t2 ON t1."XCL_177" = t2."XCL_171" WHERE t2."XCL_173" = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
SELECT COUNT(t2."XCL_006") FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1."XCL_003" = t2."XCL_008" WHERE t1."XCL_005" = 'Italy Serie A' AND t2."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
SELECT MAX(t2."XCL_015") FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1."XCL_003" = t2."XCL_008" WHERE t1."XCL_005" = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'
SELECT "XCL_128", "XCL_138", "XCL_143" FROM Player_Attributes WHERE "XCL_130" = (SELECT "XCL_122" FROM Player ORDER BY "XCL_127" DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1
SELECT t1."XCL_005" FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1."XCL_003" = t2."XCL_008" WHERE t2."XCL_009" = '2015/2016' GROUP BY t1."XCL_005" ORDER BY COUNT(t2."XCL_006") DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT t2."XCL_173" FROM Match AS t1 INNER JOIN Team AS t2 ON t1."XCL_014" = t2."XCL_171" ORDER BY t1."XCL_016" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT t1."XCL_123" FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1."XCL_122" = t2."XCL_130" WHERE t2."XCL_132" = (SELECT MAX("XCL_132") FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t2."XCL_132" > 70 THEN t1."XCL_121" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t1."XCL_121") AS percent FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1."XCL_122" = t2."XCL_130" WHERE t1."XCL_126" < 180
